name: ISO 27018
description: Controls for protecting personal data in a public cloud. Titles name the topic. Descriptions are our own short guidance, not the standard's text.

requirements.title: Personal data in the public cloud
requirements.summary: Extra duties when the service processes personal data for customers.

children.title: Help with people's requests
children.summary: Give the customer what they need to answer a person's request about their data.

children.title: Purpose for processing
children.summary: Process personal data only for the purpose the customer agreed.

children.title: No advertising use
children.summary: Do not use customer personal data to advertise.

children.title: Temporary files are erased
children.summary: Delete temporary copies of personal data when the job that needed them is finished.

children.title: Disclosure to others
children.summary: Tell the customer before personal data is disclosed, unless the law forbids the notice.

children.title: Subprocessors
children.summary: Name the subprocessors that can see personal data and tell the customer when the list changes.

children.title: Breach notice
children.summary: Tell the customer when a breach involves their personal data.

children.title: Policy retention
children.summary: Keep the security policies that were in force, so a later review can see what applied.

children.title: Return or deletion
children.summary: Return or delete personal data when the contract ends, and say which copies remain.

children.title: Where data is stored
children.summary: Be able to say which countries hold the personal data.

children.title: Where data is meant to be stored
children.summary: Tell the customer the countries where the service is designed to store personal data.
